en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1.  Imam  Zainul  Abideen  (a.s.)  said,  “The  human  tongue does a favor on other parts of the body every day. It inquires about their condition. The parts of body say: If you spare us, we  will  remain  in  good  condition.  They  beg  for  Allah’s mercy and say that if they are rewarded, it is because of the tongue and if they are punished, it is also because of the tongue.”
